wikitext: :[The panel shows a shaded sphere with a rocket launched from its top to the right. Several trajectories are plotted around the sphere.] :[Trajectory 1 (in black) shows a successful circular orbit.] :Humans slip the bonds of Earth to travel the stars :[Trajectory 2 (in red) shows a ballistic arc that crashes into the sphere near the bottom.] :Civilization ends in fire :[Trajectory 3 (in red) shows a much shorter ballistic arc. No label.] :[Caption below the panel:] :In retrospect, Newton's little cannonball drawing does a surprisingly good job illustrating the range of possible futures of our species.
